page_summary: This chapter discusses the importance of effective cybersecurity governance in ports, emphasizing the role of international frameworks, national legislation, and organizational arrangements in shaping cybersecurity resilience. It highlights the International Maritime Organization (IMO) and its International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code as key components in establishing security governance, although the Code primarily addresses physical security risks. Recommendations for strengthening cybersecurity governance in ports are also provided.
